title: AuralPaths: a research and teaching tool for the precedence effect in sound reinforcement
description: Browser-based binaural room simulator for direct sound plus delayed loudspeaker (PA) paths: vary hall, loudspeaker and seat positions, delay and level, then compute, listen to and export binaural room impulse responses (SOFA, WAV). Image sources, ray tracing and first-order edge diffraction; shoebox, drawn 2.5D and OBJ 3D halls; calibration of absorption to measured T30; checks against measured halls (BRAS, Fratoni). Third-party data included in the repository keep their own licences (see NOTICE.md).
